content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Prasar Bharati Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.newsonair.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 20-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Prasar Bharati RRU Ahmedabad for engaging Part-Time Correspondents across multiple districts in Gujarat.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post offered in Prasar Bharati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post offered is Part-Time Correspondent (PTC) under contract retainer-ship basis.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies available for different districts in Gujarat under this notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to send the filled offline application form is 20-10-2026 through Speed Post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate/Diploma in Journalism/Mass Media or Graduation with a minimum of 2 years of journalistic experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Applicants must be between 24 to 50 years of age as per the notification guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it by post to the specified address.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary or retainer-ship fee provided?
faq.answer: The salary is based on usable stories, starting with Rs. 2000/- for a minimum of 5 usable stories, with additional per-story rates applicable.

faq.question: Q9. Where should I send the completed application form?
faq.answer: The application must be sent by Speed Post to Pradeshiyak Samachar Vibhag, Akashvani Bhavan, Income Tax Office Same, Navrangpura, Ahmedabad, Gujarat - 380009.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website to download the notification and form?
faq.answer: Candidates can visit the official website at www.newsonair.gov.in to download the application form and notification details.
